definitions.explanation: A flat instrument with straight edges used for measuring length or drawing straight lines.

examples.english: To draw a line with a ruler.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{定規|じょうぎ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧30⟦センチ→センチ：01372_senchi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{測|はか}れる→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: This ruler can measure up to 30 centimeters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{三角|さんかく}→三角：04177_sankaku⟧{定規|じょうぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{角度|かくど}→角度：00156_kakudo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}いた→描く：noentry⟧。
examples.english: I drew an angle using a triangular ruler.
examples.notes: 三角定規 = set square, triangular ruler

notes:
{定規|じょうぎ} refers to a ruler used for measuring or drawing straight lines. The term emphasizes the straightness and precision of the tool.

TYPES OF RULERS:
- ⟦{三角|さんかく}→三角：04177_sankaku⟧{定規|じょうぎ}: set square, triangular ruler
- ⟦{直|ちょく}→直：noentry⟧{定規|じょうぎ}: straight ruler
- ⟦{分度器|ぶんどき}→分度器：05596_bundoki⟧: protractor (for measuring angles)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{物差|ものさ}し→物差し：05480_monosashi⟧: ruler (alternative term, often for longer measuring sticks)
- ⟦メジャー→メジャー：11595_mejaa⟧: tape measure
